evals.prompt: 使用 testspec-new 新建变更，变更名固定为 synthetic-account-signin。读取 docs/synthetic-signin-prd.md，生成 proposal.md 和 requirements.md，但不要继续做 analysis。
evals.expected_output: 创建固定变更目录，净化合成 PRD，并建立 version 1 canonical context。

files.content:
# Synthetic Account Sign-in

用户可使用邮箱和密码登录。密码连续错误 5 次后锁定 30 分钟。管理员账号必须启用二次验证。所有内容均为合成测试数据。

assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-account-signin && test -d "$DIR/specs" && test -d "$DIR/artifacts" && test -f "$DIR/proposal.md" && test -f "$DIR/requirements.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Seeds canonical revision version 1 without stale downstream artifacts
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json,re; p='testspec/changes/synthetic-account-signin/requirements.md'; t=open(p).read(); d=json.loads(re.findall(r'<!--\\s*testspec-context\\s*(\\{.*?\\})\\s*-->',t,re.S)[-1]); assert d['source_revision']['version']==1 and d['source_revision']['updated_by_skill']=='testspec-new' and d['stale_downstream_artifacts']==[]; print('PASS')" 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Keeps the source traceable and does not generate downstream analysis
assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-account-signin && grep -q 'docs/synthetic-signin-prd.md' "$DIR/requirements.md" && test ! -e "$DIR/requirements-analysis.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

evals.prompt: 使用 testspec-new 新建 synthetic-document-import。需求只有：支持导入文档，响应速度要合理。先做 PRD Intake，一次只问一个最高影响问题。
evals.expected_output: 创建低质量材料的 proposal/requirements，保留不可验收表述为阻塞问题，不虚构阈值。

assertions.text: Creates the named change and requirements intake output
assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-document-import && test -f "$DIR/proposal.md" && test -f "$DIR/requirements.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Does not convert reasonable speed into a fabricated acceptance threshold
Marks the requirement as needing clarification and records exactly the highest-impact user-facing question
Still creates a version 1 canonical context
assertions.script: grep -Eq '"version"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*1' testspec/changes/synthetic-document-import/requirements.md && grep -q 'blocking_open_questions' testspec/changes/synthetic-document-import/requirements.md && echo PASS || echo FAIL
